# MilitaryAutonomyEthics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The set of principles and safeguards governing the deployment of autonomous weapons and decision systems to ensure human oversight and compliance with laws of war. Shapes the design constraints for TCC/iNEST systems, requiring verifiable and explainable behavior in networked neuromorphic deployments.
